_meta.title: Backroom cruising A+B retained listings QA 86–90
_meta.method: Date-stamped cruising directory posts and historical map URLs contrasted with official municipal tourism, land management and open data. Specific gay beach usage corroborated by independent specialized guides. Directory creation date and online interest are not proof of physical visit.

records.name: Parking río Llobregat El Prat
records.identity: ORIGINAL source's detailed Spanish directions say from Barcelona take C-31 exit 194B to roundabout, then access road toward Llobregat riverside, small parking to right. Original Gays-Cruising maps route destination is 41.3368644714,2.096414566; this corrects current listing with no lat/lon and description saying nearest bridge/bank unidentifiable. The map is original-source PIN, but it hasn't independently established public parking rules, current entrance condition or same exact spot as another riverside car park.

activity.detail: No evidence of physical visit or encounter.

records.access: Llobregat estuary includes protected habitats and differing parking lots and paths; DO NOT confuse original 41.336864,2.096415 point with the official El Prat natural area/Cal Tet parking at approximately 41.308806,2.112025, which is geographically a different car park. Current direct source entry doesn't prove legal motor access.
records.duplicates: Original region has several Llobregat parking locations; no duplicate should be merged without GPS and route comparison.
corrections: MATERIAL: replace 'unidentified general riverside parking with no source pin' assessment in research with original exact map destination and quoted exit 194B.
Site listing should not be modified without owner approval.
Digital check-in dated 2026 does not prove active cruising.

records.name: Maspalomas gay beach — Kiosk 7
records.identity: Longstanding gay/naturist section on Maspalomas beach shore between Playa del Inglés and Faro, historically referred to as 'Kiosk 7'. Independent 2026 guide listings now put much of gay male sunbathing near kiosks 5/6, but other updated guides still use #7. This is one continuous broad social-beach stretch, not an exact individual permanent kiosk pin. Existing 27.73612,-15.58425 is broad beach location only.

activity.detail: Beach's current LGBT identity independently confirmed by gay travel sources; this does not verify sex acts, a sex-approved location or precise busy times.

records.access: Foot access via beach shore/marked official trail; dunes behind are protected natural reserve, off-trail dunes and fences should be avoided. Public/paid beach kiosks are not gay sex venues, and labeled kiosks can change operators/numbers.
records.duplicates: Existing Backroom dunes listing and 'gay beach' naming may refer nearby but distinct protected dune area; preserve coastal beach separately and compare other generic gay beach records before importing duplicate.
corrections: In future owner-approved copy prefer 'Maspalomas Gay Beach — Kiosks 5–7 / historic Kiosk 7 area' rather than promising a fixed #7 as precise gathering point.
Source claims about which precise kiosk is most gay conflict, so avoid inventing a definitive current kiosk number.
Independent sources support beach's gay social role more strongly than single uncorroborated directory spot.

Older naming corroboration only, not recent visit.

records.duplicates: Independent Cruisingmap record is same named place, not separate new location; consolidate names but keep source URLs as evidence.
corrections: Second-directory page shows zero visible guest messages; don't interpret visible synthetic profile widgets as actual cruisers at this venue.

records.name: Jardines del Guadalquivir
records.identity: Jardines del Guadalquivir, Isla de la Cartuja Seville, park ~8 hectares between Puente de la Barqueta and Jardín Americano. Same park identified independently in Gays-Cruising, Cruisingmap and Jul30 2025 independent El Español reporting. Saved 37.39815,-6.00432 is general gardens locator, not exact historical garden maze path.

activity.detail: Original directory comments not independently reported completed onsite encounter.
Press reports past cruising, not current specific sexual activity.

records.access: Seville municipality completed central walking-path rehabilitation by July 2025 (€90,857.43; 6,163m²) and planted thousands of shrubs and trees. Full restoration and Andalusian government-to-municipality ownership arrangement remained pending as of Jul2025 press. Don't infer all paths unchanged, fully reopened or a park closure in 2026.
records.duplicates: Separate from nearby Parque del Alamillo and generic Ribera del Guadalquivir riverbank; no automatic merge.
corrections: Independent historical cruising documentation is supported; contemporary 2026 specific sexual activity unverified.
Current vegetation and restored paths can differ from old maze/hedge directions.
Gated hours/current entry operator still not established and should not be guessed.

records.name: Polígono Industrial Mas Puigvert
records.identity: Mas Puigvert industrial estate, Antic Camí de Tordera 08389 Palafolls, not municipality Tordera. Independent live Diputació de Barcelona Open Data industrial registry (refreshed Nov 4 2026) lists SANDOZ site 'POL MAS PUIGVERT S/N SECTOR 19-20' in Ajuntament de Palafolls, with point around 41.6871549,2.7391562, corroborating industrial estate physically present. Saved 41.68723,2.73267 general industrial area point need not be replaced with a company's parcel GPS as the alleged cruising spot.

activity.detail: Original regional index shows comment, no visible firsthand encounter text.

records.access: Operating industrial estate with private factory/loading premises, road traffic, no verified general public car-park/meeting subsection.
records.duplicates: Tordera categorization and Palafolls city describe same named business park, not 2 distinct sites. Preserve original alias in source history.
corrections: Strong civic open-data corroboration of municipality Palafolls; user-listed City field already correct.
Don't change saved point to Sandoz factory GPS because it is not source reported cruising location.
